name: Nova Organic Public Company Limited
summary: Nova Organic Public Company Limited specializes in the production and distribution of nutritional supplements and health drinks. Its extensive market spans Thailand, other parts of Southeast Asia, Europe, and Hong Kong. The company's diverse product range includes beauty-enhancing dietary aids under the "Donutt collagen" and "Donutt Total fiberly" brands, as well as comprehensive wellness supplements marketed as "LIVNEST." Additionally, it offers various other products such as Lingzhi Plus Shitake, Matsutake, Chompoo24, and Q-Tin, with the latter specifically addressing hair and scalp health. Founded in 2013, the firm's headquarters are located in Phra Samut Chedi, Thailand.
